session.lane_assignment_note: The session prompt names no session-specific method paragraph ('your lane is the single method paragraph below' but no such paragraph is present in the prompt as received; same irregularity flagged as IR-78CS-02 by session 3). The lane was therefore self-assigned as the top-ranked hypothesis of research/h78step_hypotheses.md, written before any result, which is also deferred hypothesis #1 in docs/review-release.md. If a parallel session was assigned cross-strike profile/step features, dedupe against evidence/h78step_*.

hypothesis: Buried or blind normal faults that lack a mappable scarp still offset the subsurface across strike: on the downthrown side basement deepens, isostatic gravity and surface elevation fall, and conductive basin fill thickens. Paired flank-mean steps at +/-300, +/-600 and +/-1000 m across the regional strike, normalised by local variability, on magnetics, gravity, basement depth, topography and conductivity, together with explicit cross-layer sign-concordance features (shared throw direction), therefore recover withheld fault segments better than the pointwise steered-derivative learner (H78-A) under an identical emitter.
mechanism: For each footprint pixel, with the strike-normal n and tangent t from the visible-catalogue strike field phi (orientation only, never location), sample Gaussian(sigma=1 px)-smoothed bands along the normal at offsets -10,-6,-3,0,3,6,10 px, each point averaged over tangent offsets -3,0,+3 px. Per band (det_elev, rtp, iso_grav_anom, depth_to_base_surf, cond_surf): signed step (v(+k)-v(-k))/(local sigma-10px std at centre + 0.05*global std) for k=3,6,10, its absolute value, and centre deviation (v(0)-(v(+6)+v(-6))/2)/denom signed + abs = 8 features x 5 bands = 40. Concordance from signed steps at k=6 and k=10 (magnetic step excluded from sign logic: anomaly sign depends on magnetisation, not throw): throw_z=(depth -elev -grav +cond)/4, abs, products -depth*elev, -depth*grav, elev*grav, depth*cond, and weakest-concordant min_i(o_i * sign(throw_z)) with o=(depth,-elev,-grav,cond) = 7 x 2 scales = 14. Total 54 STEP features. depth_to_base_surf enters via the stack's pinned log1p transform (data.py LOG_BANDS), disclosed.
named_non_fault_mimic: Intrusive or lithologic contacts (magnetic + gravity step with no fault); basin-margin facies changes and buried paleochannels (conductivity / basement-depth step). The concordance block exists so no single band's step suffices: a contact usually lacks the elevation+gravity+depth throw-consistent combination, a paleochannel lacks the magnetic/gravity basement step.
why_missing_not_catalogued: The USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue is a mapping compilation; the strands most likely missing are buried piedmont/intrabasin faults whose surface expression is below a mapper's threshold but whose basement offset persists in potential fields and depth-to-basement. The step signature is learned from visible faults (which also offset basement) but the catalogue's location is never a feature, so the model is not paid to re-find mapped traces.
differs_from_repo_prior: H78-A: pointwise steered derivatives at sigma 1.5/3 px centred on the pixel (ridge/step at <=300 m, unnormalised, no flank windows, no cross-layer concordance). H78-CS: along-strike integrals of those same derivatives (negative, duplicate). H78-MPC: contrast-invariant phase-congruency edges with no offset amount or throw direction. H78-SPY: same A2 model with PU-cleaned negatives (negative, duplicate). CAND_STEP contains NO steered-derivative (iso or steered) columns at all: raw19 + 54 cross-strike flank-profile features, so it is a distinct model class, not an append to A2 (session-3 measurement: appends to A2 land at surface rho ~0.95 / dot overlap ~0.89 vs H78-A).

holdout.draw: gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw(seed=20, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3) exactly as lanes H78-A/H78-MPC/H78-CS (11,321 withheld positives expected; asserted)
holdout.scoring: pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 triangular 300 m kernel; visible faults masked pixel-exactly; 95% CI paired 20 km block bootstrap (1000 draws, seed 520810) via pooled_summary
holdout.training: one model per arm on ALL visible catalogue cells (deployment-faithful, as H78-A); negatives pipeline.training_sample(fp, visible, 450000, seed=20), flank 2 px, withheld cells not excluded; identical rows for every arm; HGB max_iter=300 lr=0.06 max_leaf_nodes=63 min_samples_leaf=200 l2=1.0 max_bins=255 early_stopping=False random_state=0 (session-identical to H78-CS run_holdout_cs.py)
holdout.catalogue_derived_inputs: strike field phi only, from visible cells (pipeline.build_feature_matrix tag seed20); STEP profiles use that same visible-only phi; no distance/density/location features
holdout.secondary_stratum: far-truth: withheld truth >10 px from any visible fault, same dots, reported separately; not part of the promote gate

uniqueness_rule: Frozen indexed registry = 9 rasters: H19-5 solid, D2.8, H33-2-B2 (data/registry, pinned in registry/data_manifest.json), GEMS70 p5-submodular-multiphysics-hydro 54k (data/registry/gems70_p5_submod_54000.tif, sha256 00e8e1cb6ea34dbe2f6dc0ba3b7cc0d8d18ae2b0aaec11552bfa3ef11f1ea9f2 fetched 2026-10-22 from buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE70 blob cd915f3f..., the comparator that failed H78-MPC at 0.730), and shipped-in-this-repo H78-A primary, H78-A altB2, H78-MPC, H78-SPY, H78-CS (docs/downloads). Gate: |Spearman rho| of candidate score surface vs each <=0.90 BEFORE placement; fraction of final dots within 3 px of each (literal FORWARD overlap) <=0.70; final-dot surface |rho| <=0.90; holdout score-surface rho(CAND_STEP, CTRL_A2) <=0.90. SCOPE DISCLOSURE: this is an indexed, locally-verified registry, not the organizer's complete submission history; space-filling lattice rasters known in the family (3-px halo covers 99.87% of the footprint, evidence/h78mpc_uniqueness.json) make the literal rule unsatisfiable by ANY dot set and are therefore reported as a standing irregularity of the rule, not silently included or excluded: no claim of global uniqueness is made.
